name: Souvenirs of Death
summary: At Tarren Mill, Deathguard Samsa envies those sent against the human settlements of the Hillsbrad Foothills. He asks for thirty human skulls taken in battle for his collection.

sections.title: A Guard's Envy
sections.body: High Executor Darthalia directs the Forsaken campaign against Hillsbrad's human settlements. Deathguard Samsa remains on sentry duty in Tarren Mill, while others are sent to raid, burn, and pillage. He envies their chance to slaughter the living, a privilege denied to a guard fixed in place.

sections.title: A Gruesome Trophy
sections.body: Samsa hates the humans of Hillsbrad and collects the skulls of those slain in the campaign. He asks for thirty, not for an arcane rite or military plan, but as trophies from a war he longs to fight himself.

faq.q: Who offers this quest and where are they located?
faq.answer: Deathguard Samsa offers it from his sentry post in Tarren Mill, the main Forsaken stronghold in northern Hillsbrad Foothills.
Samsa asks for thirty Hillsbrad Human Skulls from human combatants and townsfolk across Hillsbrad Fields and the town of Hillsbrad.

faq.q: Why does Samsa want human skulls?
faq.answer: Samsa collects macabre trophies. Confined to garrison duty in Tarren Mill while others wage war, he gathers skulls to share in the slaughter of the living from afar.

faq.q: When does this quest become available?
faq.answer: Samsa approaches you after you enlist with High Executor Darthalia and complete the opening assault in the Battle of Hillsbrad campaign.

faq.q: Are the skulls used for Forsaken alchemy or magic?
faq.answer: No. Samsa's request is personal, unlike Royal Apothecary Society assignments that seek biological reagents for the New Plague. He finds the severed skulls beautiful and cherishes them as souvenirs of war.
The skulls come from human farmers, peasants, militia, and defenders in Hillsbrad Fields or the town of Hillsbrad, where you fight for Tarren Mill.

angles.text: As a Horde champion, you take part in the push against Alliance strongholds in Lordaeron, securing northern supply routes for Tarren Mill.
As an undead champion, you see the casual cruelty and deep animosity many Forsaken hold toward living humans who view them as monsters.
As an Alliance champion, you face the brutal, existential threat the Forsaken pose to Hillsbrad's surviving townsfolk, marked by their systematic collection of severed human heads.
